no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: As of May 2026 Addex Therapeutics has no actively recruiting / ongoing Phase 1/2/3 trial sponsored by the company. Dipraglurant (mGlu5 NAM) Phase 2a in blepharospasm produced inconclusive 2022 data and is awaiting partnering for post-stroke / TBI recovery. ADX71149 (mGlu2 PAM, partnered with Janssen / Indivior) failed its Phase 2 epilepsy trial in April 2024. GABAB PAM (substance use disorder, chronic cough), mGlu7 NAM (anxiety) and other programs are all preclinical / candidate-selection stage. NTX-253 (M4 PAM Phase 1 for schizophrenia) belongs to spin-out Neurosterix, not Addex.
